name: Elide Toolchain

crypto_published_justification: Integrity verification uses SHA-256 through Node crypto and standard sha256sum/shasum tools; HTTPS uses standard Node/curl TLS implementations, not project-defined cryptographic algorithms. https://github.com/elide-dev/toolchain/blob/main/action/main.ts

crypto_working_justification: Default integrity checks use SHA-256 and release downloads use HTTPS with certificate verification. Optional legacy algorithms exposed by bundled general-purpose crypto libraries are not used as toolchain security defaults. https://github.com/elide-dev/toolchain/blob/main/scripts/lib/common.sh
crypto_weaknesses_justification: Default integrity checks use SHA-256 and release downloads use HTTPS with certificate verification. crypto_password_storage_justification: The toolchain and installer do not authenticate external users or maintain a password database. Caller tokens are credentials, not user-password storage.
delivery_unsigned_justification: Source and release assets are served over HTTPS. Versioned SHA-256 sidecars accompany the bundles. https://github.com/elide-dev/toolchain/releases
vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days_justificat: No public GitHub advisories were found on 2026-11-08. Maintainers must also review private reports and other channels before confirming timing, outstanding vulnerabilities, release disclosures or N/A credit history.
vulnerabilities_critical_fixed_justifica: No public GitHub advisories were found on 2026-11-08. Maintainers must also review private reports and other channels before confirming timing, outstanding vulnerabilities, release disclosures or N/A credit history.
no_leaked_credentials_justification: Secret scanning and push protection are enabled, but maintainers must review alerts/history and confirm any exposed credentials were revoked. Enabled scanning alone is not proof.
static_analysis_justification: ShellCheck runs on the maintained build scripts and POSIX helper as part of CI; shellcheck -x and -s sh inspect code beyond compiler warnings. This does not claim full native SAST coverage. https://github.com/elide-dev/toolchain/blob/main/tests/run.sh
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: ShellCheck analyzes the orchestration scripts; no native static analyzer with documented common memory-safety checks is currently configured for first-party allocator code.
